title: Parts Velocity On Hand still counts only positive bins for a part with a negative bin
custom_preconds: • A tracked part with sales in the date range and bins +1 and -3 (e.g. 76-3327PK).
custom_steps:
1. Reports > Inventory Value, today: search the part.
  2. Reports > Parts Velocity (a date range with its sales): search the part.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Qty (-2.00), the net of its bins.

Step 2:

  • On Hand 1.00 (positive bins only), unchanged by this release. The difference from Inventory Value is intended.
